name: Hotel Fixture
positioning: Small clifftop hotel above the sea

facts.text: The hotel has 40 rooms, each with a sea-facing terrace.
A lift cut through the cliff takes guests down to a private beach.
The restaurant cooks with produce from the hotel's own terraced garden.

highlights.text: Every room looks straight out to sea.
Private beach reached by the cliff lift.

considerations.text: The hotel closes in winter, roughly November to March.
Getting into town means a boat or a steep walk with many steps.
